card.name: Sterile and injection wording in preparation text
card.fires_on: Words like sterile, injection, or the middle of sterile/chloride in dosing and preparation instructions, plus an occasional stray word such as Reader after Adobe Acrobat.

modes.label: Sterile
modes.description: The word sterile (or its inner piece) describing syringes, solutions, drapes or gloves.
modes.example: The AHZANTIVE pre-filled syringe is<< sterile>> and for one-time use in one eye

modes.label: Injection after drug name
modes.description: The word injection following a drug name, as in cefepime for injection.

modes.label: Inside long words
modes.description: Partway through a longer word such as hydrochloride.
